dialogue.nirncraft.faction.bards_college: I'd like to join the Bards College.
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.civil_war.wor: Reporting for duty. Any orders for the %s?
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.college.join: I want to join the College of Winterhold.
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.companions.jo: I want to join the Companions.
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.dark_brotherh: Do you have a contract for me?
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.imperial_legi: I want to join the Imperial Legion.
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.stormcloaks.j: I want to join the Stormcloaks.
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.thieves_guild: Can you take care of my bounty?
Clear my bounty in %s (%s) for %s gold.
I hear you can help someone like me.
dialogue.nirncraft.faction.work: Do you have any work for the %s?
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.fetch: Here are the %s %s you asked for.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.help: Do you need help with anything?
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.jarl: I need to speak to the Jarl.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.ledger: I'm here about the ledger. Brynjolf sends his regards.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.letter: I have a letter for you.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.skeevers_done: The skeevers won't trouble your field again.
faction.nirncraft.bards_college.desc: The oldest school of music and verse in Skyrim, keepers of the songs of heroes. They pay well for instruments.
faction.nirncraft.bards_college.join: Ask a librarian: "I'd like to join the Bards College." Bring them instruments to prove your worth.
faction.nirncraft.college.desc: Skyrim's only institute of magical learning, perched on a crumbling spire above the Sea of Ghosts. The Nords distrust it, which suits the mages just fine.
faction.nirncraft.college.join: Talk to a librarian once you know at least three spells.
faction.nirncraft.companions.beast_blood: The Beast Blood courses through you: +5%% damage.
faction.nirncraft.companions.desc: An ancient order of warriors who take contracts from those in need. They value honor, strength and glory above all. Their hall, Jorrvaskr, stands in the shadow of the Skyforge.
faction.nirncraft.companions.join: Ask a weaponsmith or a guard: "I want to join the Companions." You must prove yourself by killing bandits or beasts.
faction.nirncraft.dark_brotherhood.desc: A secretive cult of assassins who answer the prayers of those performing the Black Sacrament. Sneaking up on a contract target pays 50%% more.
faction.nirncraft.dark_brotherhood.join: Take a life, and the Night Mother may whisper to you at night. Then find a wandering trader in the dark: "Silence, my brother."
faction.nirncraft.imperial_legion.desc: The army of the Empire, sworn to keep Skyrim within it. Disciplined, well equipped and sworn enemies of the Stormcloaks.
faction.nirncraft.imperial_legion.join: Ask a guard: "I want to join the Imperial Legion." You can't serve both sides of the civil war.
faction.nirncraft.rival_member: You are sworn to the %s. They would never accept a traitor.
faction.nirncraft.stormcloaks.desc: Ulfric Stormcloak's rebels, fighting to free Skyrim from the Empire and restore the worship of Talos.
faction.nirncraft.stormcloaks.join: Ask a guard: "I want to join the Stormcloaks." You can't serve both sides of the civil war.
faction.nirncraft.thieves_guild.desc: A guild of thieves, fences and smugglers working out of the Ratway beneath Riften. Their luck has run dry, but they still have friends in every hold. Members can have their bounties quietly cleared for half price.
faction.nirncraft.thieves_guild.join: Steal at least five items, then find a wandering trader: "I hear you can help someone like me."
item.nirncraft.black_hand_letter.read: The parchment bears a single black handprint and two words: "We know." Speak to a wanderer when the night is darkest...
journal.nirncraft.empty_hint: Your journal is empty. Ask villagers if they need help, ask guards about bounties, or seek out the guilds of Skyrim.
journal.nirncraft.party_hint: Quests accepted by any member are shared by the whole party; every member receives the full reward.
journal.nirncraft.party_none: You are not in a party. Press U to form one and invite other adventurers. Party members share quests and rewards and can't hurt each other.
journal.nirncraft.sneak_bonus_hint: Kill the target while sneaking for 50%% more gold.
party.nirncraft.already_in_party: You are already in a party.
party.nirncraft.created: You formed a party. Invite others with /party invite <player> or the Party menu (U).
party.nirncraft.invite_received: %s invites you to their party. Type /party accept or open the Party menu (U).
party.nirncraft.no_party: You are not in a party.
party.nirncraft.no_invite: You have no pending party invitations.
party.nirncraft.not_in_party: You are not in a party.
party.nirncraft.not_leader: Only the party leader can do that.
party.nirncraft.not_member: That player is not in your party.
party.nirncraft.screen.leader_invites: Only the party leader can invite.
party.nirncraft.screen.title: Party
party.nirncraft.travel.combat: You can't fast travel while enemies are nearby.
party.nirncraft.travel.disabled: Fast travel is disabled on this server.
party.nirncraft.travel.falling: You can't fast travel while falling.
party.nirncraft.travel.jail: You can't fast travel from jail.
party.nirncraft.travel.not_member: That adventurer is not in your party.
party.nirncraft.travel.target_jail: %s is in jail. Best not to visit.
party.nirncraft.travel.title: Fast Travel
party.nirncraft.you_were_kicked: You were removed from the party.
quest.nirncraft.bards_instruments.title: Bards: Lost Instruments
quest.nirncraft.bards_trial.desc: %1$s at the Bards College wants instruments for the festival before I'm allowed to join.
quest.nirncraft.bards_trial.title: Tending the Flames
quest.nirncraft.bounty_bandit.desc: The Jarl of %4$s has placed a bounty on %1$s, leader of the bandits at %2$s, to the %3$s.
quest.nirncraft.bounty_bandit.title: Bounty: Bandit Leader
quest.nirncraft.bounty_deathlord.desc: Something ancient has awoken in %1$s, to the %2$s. The Jarl of %3$s wants the Draugr Deathlord within destroyed.
quest.nirncraft.bounty_deathlord.title: Bounty: Draugr Deathlord
quest.nirncraft.bounty_dragon.desc: The dragon %1$s has been sighted to the %2$s. The Jarl of %3$s has called for anyone brave enough to slay it.
quest.nirncraft.bounty_dragon.title: Bounty: Dragon
quest.nirncraft.bounty_giant.desc: A giant has been terrorizing the farms of %2$s. It was last seen to the %1$s.
quest.nirncraft.bounty_giant.title: A Giant Problem
quest.nirncraft.cmd.no_offer: No quest could be generated here
quest.nirncraft.college_necromancer.desc: The necromancer %1$s has been raising the dead to the %2$s. The College wants the matter handled quietly.
quest.nirncraft.college_tome.desc: The College wants a tome recovered from %1$s, to the %2$s, before the necromancers get their hands on it.
quest.nirncraft.college_tome.title: College: Forbidden Knowledge
quest.nirncraft.companions_bandits.desc: %1$s and their band have been robbing caravans to the %2$s. The Companions have been hired to end it.
quest.nirncraft.companions_bandits.title: Companions: Trouble in Skyrim
quest.nirncraft.companions_beasts.desc: Beasts have been attacking travelers to the %1$s. The Companions have been paid to deal with them.
quest.nirncraft.companions_beasts.title: Companions: Animal Extermination
quest.nirncraft.companions_giant.desc: A giant to the %1$s has been bothering the farmers. The Companions have taken the contract.
quest.nirncraft.companions_giant.title: Companions: Hunt the Giant
quest.nirncraft.companions_trial.desc: To join the Companions I must prove my strength. Kodlak wants to see me cut down bandits or beasts.
quest.nirncraft.companions_trial.title: Take Up Arms
quest.nirncraft.db.whisper_hint: A letter marked with a black hand has found its way into your pack.
quest.nirncraft.db.whisper_sub: Speak with the Night Mother's voice...
quest.nirncraft.db_contract.desc: The Night Mother has spoken. %1$s must die. The target was last seen to the %2$s.
quest.nirncraft.db_contract.title: Contract: Kill %1$s
quest.nirncraft.hunt_draugr.desc: %1$s, an ancient draugr overlord, walks the land again to the %2$s.
quest.nirncraft.hunt_draugr.title: Legendary Hunt: %1$s
quest.nirncraft.hunt_giant.desc: %1$s, the oldest and meanest giant anyone remembers, roams to the %2$s.
quest.nirncraft.hunt_giant.title: Legendary Hunt: %1$s
quest.nirncraft.hunt_skeever.desc: %1$s, a skeever grown monstrously large, leads a plague of vermin to the %2$s.
quest.nirncraft.hunt_skeever.title: Legendary Hunt: %1$s
quest.nirncraft.hunt_troll.desc: %1$s, a monstrous troll, haunts the wilds to the %2$s. The hunters of %3$s will pay well for its head.
quest.nirncraft.hunt_troll.title: Legendary Hunt: %1$s
quest.nirncraft.hunt_witch.desc: %1$s has been cursing travelers to the %2$s. Hagravens and worse answer to her.
quest.nirncraft.hunt_witch.title: Legendary Hunt: %1$s
quest.nirncraft.legion_camp.desc: Stormcloaks hold %1$s, to the %2$s. Kill their officer and break the camp.
quest.nirncraft.legion_camp.title: Legion: Rescue from %1$s
quest.nirncraft.legion_dispatch.desc: The Legion needs orders delivered to the village to the %1$s.
quest.nirncraft.legion_dispatch.title: Legion: Message to the Front
quest.nirncraft.legion_trial.desc: Legate Rikke wants proof of my loyalty: clear out the Stormcloak camp to the %1$s.
quest.nirncraft.legion_trial.title: Joining the Legion
quest.nirncraft.main.victory_broadcast: %s has slain Alduin, World-Eater! The Dragonborn has saved Skyrim.
quest.nirncraft.main.victory_sub: The World-Eater is no more. Sovngarde sings your name, Dragonborn.
quest.nirncraft.main_1.desc: Helgen is ash and I barely escaped with my life. A dragon... it can't be. I should find the nearest settlement and warn the people there.
quest.nirncraft.main_1.title: Unbound
quest.nirncraft.main_2.desc: The settlement must hear what happened at Helgen. A guard can bring me before the Jarl.
quest.nirncraft.main_2.title: Before the Storm
quest.nirncraft.main_3.desc: A dragon is attacking the watchtower to the %s. The Jarl has asked me to help bring it down.
quest.nirncraft.main_3.title: Dragon Rising
quest.nirncraft.main_4.desc: When the dragon died I absorbed its soul. The Greybeards say I am Dragonborn. I must learn a Word of Power: Word Walls are found in ancient Nordic shrines high in the mountains.
quest.nirncraft.main_4.title: The Way of the Voice
quest.nirncraft.main_5.desc: Alduin, the World-Eater, has fled to Sovngarde to devour the souls of the dead. I must follow him beyond the veil (The End) and end him once and for all.
quest.nirncraft.main_5.title: Alduin's Bane
quest.nirncraft.obj.main_2: Speak to a guard about the Jarl
quest.nirncraft.obj.main_3: Kill the dragon at the watchtower
quest.nirncraft.obj.travel_village: Travel to the village to the %s
quest.nirncraft.pitch.bards_instruments: Our instruments keep vanishing. Bring me %s %s and the College will pay %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.bards_trial: The Bards College is always looking for talent, but first make yourself useful. Bring me four note blocks for the festival.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.books: My shelves are bare. Bring me %s %s, any will do, and I'll pay %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.bounty_bandit: The Jarl wants %s dead. That bandit and his thugs hole up at %s, to the %s. Bring us his head and the bounty is %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.bounty_deathlord: Grave robbers came screaming out of %s, to the %s. Something's woken up down there: a Draugr Deathlord. %s gold to put it back to sleep. Permanently.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.bounty_dragon: A dragon has been sighted to the %2$s. They call it %1$s. Gods help us... The Jarl will pay %3$s gold to whoever brings it down.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.bounty_giant: A giant's been smashing up farms to the %s. Kill it and the Jarl will pay %s gold. Don't let it swat you into the sky.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.clay: I need %s %s to finish the Jarl's new wall. %s gold if you can find it.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.coal: My forge is going cold. %s %s would keep it burning. I'll pay %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.college_necromance: A former student of ours, %s, has taken up necromancy to the %s. The College would rather this... not reach the Jarl. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.college_tome: The Arch-Mage needs a tome from %s, to the %s. Bring it back intact and the College will pay %s gold, and a spell tome of your choosing. Well, of my choosing.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.companions_bandits: A merchant hired us to deal with some bandits to the %s. Kill their leader and the rest will scatter. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.companions_beasts: Wild beasts to the %s. A farmer paid us to clear them out. %s gold, and your share of the glory.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.companions_giant: There's a giant to the %s that thinks the farms are its pasture. Show it otherwise. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.companions_trial: You want to join the Companions? Words are cheap. Go out there and kill five bandits or beasts. Then we'll talk.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.db_contract_lone: Someone prayed to the Night Mother for the death of %s. The target camps alone in the wilds to the %s, perhaps with hired swords. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.db_contract_villag: A soul has been offered to the Night Mother. %s hides in the village to the %s. Make it quick, or make it quiet. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.feathers: My arrows won't fletch themselves. Bring me %s %s and I'll give you %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.fish: The fish aren't biting for me, but maybe they will for you. Bring me %s %s for %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.harvest: Harvest's been poor and the Jarl still wants his tithe. Bring me %s %s and I'll pay you %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.hides: I'm running out of good hides. Bring me %s %s and there's %s gold in it for you.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.hunt_draugr: The dead are walking. One of them has a name: %s. It was seen to the %s. Put it down for good and the reward is %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.hunt_giant: %s. Even other giants avoid that one. Last seen to the %s. Kill it and claim %s gold and a trophy fit for a Jarl's hall.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.hunt_skeever: Laugh all you want, but %s is no ordinary rat. It's bigger than a horse and twice as mean. Find it to the %s. %s gold for its tail.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.hunt_troll: You want a real hunt? %s. A troll the size of a longhouse, prowling to the %s. Bring back its head and the reward is %s gold, plus whatever a collector pays for the trophy.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.hunt_witch: %s. Every child in the hold knows the name. She's real, and she's been snatching travelers to the %s. End her and the Jarl pays %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.ingredients: I need ingredients for my remedies. Fetch me %s %s and the temple will pay you %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.iron: The Legion wants swords and I've no metal. Bring me %s %s and I'll pay %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.legion_camp: Stormcloaks have dug in at %s, to the %s. Kill their officer and the rest will break. %s gold, soldier.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.legion_dispatch: These orders must reach the village to the %s. Don't let the Stormcloaks intercept them. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.legion_trial: So you want to join the Legion? Prove it. There's a Stormcloak camp to the %s. Clear it out.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.meat: The tavern keeps ordering and my larder's empty. %s %s would earn you %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.paper: I'm out of paper for my maps. %s %s would be worth %s gold to me.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.stormcloak_camp: The Empire's dogs camp at %s, to the %s. Kill their captain. %s gold, brother.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.stormcloak_dispatc: Take these orders to the village to the %s. Skyrim belongs to the Nords. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.stormcloak_trial: You want to fight for Ulfric? Then bleed for him. There's an Imperial camp to the %s. Leave none standing.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.thieves_bedlam: Time to cause a little chaos. Lift %s things, anything at all, and don't get caught. %s gold for your trouble.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.thieves_fishing: Simple job: pick %s pockets. Light fingers, quiet feet. %s gold when you're done.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.thieves_numbers: A merchant in the village to the %s owes us. Go have a look at his ledger and remind him who his friends are. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.villager_courier: I've a letter that needs to reach the village to the %s, some %s paces away. The couriers won't go near the roads with all these bandits. %s gold if you deliver it.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.villager_skeevers: Skeevers! A whole nest of them, tearing up my field. Kill %s of the filthy things and I'll pay you %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.villager_tome: There's a tome I've been searching for for years. My research says it lies in %s, to the %s. Bring it to me and I'll pay %s gold. Beware: the dead don't rest easy there.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.wool: Winter's coming and everyone wants cloaks. Bring me %s %s for %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.reply.accepted: Good. May the Divines watch over you.
quest.nirncraft.reply.bounty_cleared: Done. The guards of %s won't remember your face. Pleasure doing business.
quest.nirncraft.reply.bounty_menu: Everyone has a price, even the guards. Which hold wants your head?
quest.nirncraft.reply.cant_afford: That'll cost %s gold, and you don't have it. Come back with coin.
quest.nirncraft.reply.college_refuse: Magic is not a toy. Come back when you know at least three spells. (You know %s.)
quest.nirncraft.reply.college_welcome: Impressive. Welcome to the College of Winterhold, Apprentice. Mind the ice on the bridge.
quest.nirncraft.reply.db_refuse: I don't know what you're talking about, stranger.
quest.nirncraft.reply.db_welcome: ...My darkness. Welcome to the family. The Night Mother has been watching you.
quest.nirncraft.reply.declined: Suit yourself. The offer won't stand forever.
quest.nirncraft.reply.finish_first: Finish the job you already have for the %s first.
quest.nirncraft.reply.jarl: The Jarl will see you. Dragons, you say? Then you'd better head for the watchtower before it's ash.
quest.nirncraft.reply.ledger: The ledger? Fine, fine! Take a look, just tell your friends I paid in full.
quest.nirncraft.reply.letter: A letter? For me? I haven't had news from home in months... Thank you, traveler.
quest.nirncraft.reply.no_bounty: Your record's as clean as a temple floor. Nothing to take care of.
quest.nirncraft.reply.no_work: I've nothing more for you today. Come back tomorrow.
quest.nirncraft.reply.not_enough: That's only %s of the %s %s I asked for.
quest.nirncraft.reply.nothing: Me? No, I'm fine. Thanks for asking.
quest.nirncraft.reply.orders: Orders from command? Hand them over. Tell them we'll hold the line.
quest.nirncraft.reply.thanks: You have my thanks. Here, take this for your trouble.
quest.nirncraft.reply.thieves_refuse: Help you? You've never lifted so much as a sweetroll. Come back when you've got some sticky fingers.
quest.nirncraft.reply.thieves_welcome: Brynjolf was right about you. Welcome to the Thieves Guild, Footpad. Don't make us regret it.
quest.nirncraft.reply.too_busy: You look like you've got enough on your plate already.
quest.nirncraft.sneak_bonus: Silent kill: the Dark Brotherhood pays 50%% extra
quest.nirncraft.stormcloak_camp.desc: Imperials hold %1$s, to the %2$s. Kill their captain and free the land.
quest.nirncraft.stormcloak_camp.title: Stormcloaks: Liberation of %1$s
quest.nirncraft.stormcloak_dispatch.desc: Ulfric's orders must reach the village to the %1$s.
quest.nirncraft.stormcloak_trial.desc: Galmar Stone-Fist wants me to prove my mettle: clear out the Imperial camp to the %1$s.
quest.nirncraft.stormcloak_trial.title: Joining the Stormcloaks
quest.nirncraft.thieves_bedlam.desc: The Guild wants to remind a town who really runs things. Steal %1$s items, any items, without getting caught.
quest.nirncraft.thieves_bedlam.title: The Bedlam Job
quest.nirncraft.thieves_fishing.desc: The Guild needs fresh coin. Pick %1$s pockets without being caught.
quest.nirncraft.thieves_fishing.title: The Fishing Job
quest.nirncraft.thieves_numbers.desc: A merchant in the village to the %1$s has been cooking his books. I need to see that ledger.
quest.nirncraft.thieves_numbers.title: The Numbers Job
quest.nirncraft.too_many: Your journal is full: finish or abandon a quest first (max %s).
quest.nirncraft.villager_courier.desc: %3$s gave me a sealed letter for someone in the village to the %1$s, about %2$s paces away.
quest.nirncraft.villager_courier.title: Special Delivery
quest.nirncraft.villager_fetch.title: Bring %1$s %2$s
quest.nirncraft.villager_skeevers.desc: %1$s in %2$s has a skeever problem. The vermin are eating the crops and someone needs to clear them out.
quest.nirncraft.villager_skeevers.title: Skeevers in the Field
quest.nirncraft.villager_tome.desc: %3$s believes an ancient tome lies in %1$s, to the %2$s. The ruin is said to be haunted by draugr. I should clear it out and bring the tome back.
quest.nirncraft.villager_tome.title: The Ancient Tome
tooltip.nirncraft.ancient_tome: Bound in cracked leather. The Nordic script seems to shift as you read it.
tooltip.nirncraft.courier_letter: Sealed with wax. Better not to break it.
tooltip.nirncraft.monster_trophy: Proof of a legendary kill. Merchants and collectors pay handsomely for it.
quest.nirncraft.obj.main_1a: Check your survival gear at the camp wreckage
quest.nirncraft.obj.main_1b: Scavenge an iron blade for defense
quest.nirncraft.obj.main_1c: Acquire defense: a shield and Novice Flames spell tome
quest.nirncraft.obj.main_1e: Follow the paved road to the nearest settlement
quest.nirncraft.nomagic_failed: You used magic! Honor challenge forfeited.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.challenges: Do you have any special challenges?
quest.nirncraft.challenge_stealth.title: Silent Infiltration: %s
quest.nirncraft.challenge_stealth.desc: Infiltrate %2$s to the %3$s and assassinate %1$s without direct confrontation.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.challenge_stealth: A high-value target, %s, is holed up at %s (%s). We want them eliminated quietly. %s gold if done unseen.
quest.nirncraft.challenge_timed.title: Pursuit of Fleeing Raiders
quest.nirncraft.challenge_timed.desc: Intercept and defeat fleeing raiders to the %s before time expires.
quest.nirncraft.obj.challenge_timed: Defeat fleeing raiders before time runs out
quest.nirncraft.pitch.challenge_timed: Raiders just struck to the %s! You have 4 minutes to intercept them. %4$s gold if you stop them in time.
quest.nirncraft.challenge_nomagic.title: Duel of Steel: %s
quest.nirncraft.challenge_nomagic.desc: Defeat %s in combat using only physical steel, archery, or fists.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.challenge_nomagic: %s challenges all warriors to the %2$s. Pure Nordic steel only — no magic. Reward is %3$s gold.
quest.nirncraft.challenge_escort.title: Wayfarer's Escort
quest.nirncraft.challenge_escort.desc: Escort the traveler safely to the outpost to the %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.challenge_escort: A traveler needs armed protection heading %s. Deliver them safely for %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.side_golden_claw.title: The Golden Claw
quest.nirncraft.side_golden_claw.desc: Recover the stolen antique dragon claw from Bleak Falls Barrow.
quest.nirncraft.obj.golden_claw_1: Ascend the mountain to Bleak Falls Barrow
quest.nirncraft.obj.golden_claw_2: Retrieve the Golden Claw from Arvel the Swift
quest.nirncraft.obj.golden_claw_3: Return the Golden Claw to the trader
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.pitch_golden_cl: Bandits raided my shop! They took an antique golden dragon claw. Track them to Bleak Falls Barrow and bring it back!
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.golden_claw_ret: I have returned your golden claw.
quest.nirncraft.reply.golden_claw_thanks: By the gods, you found it! Here is your reward, and you will always have a friend in Riverwood.
quest.nirncraft.side_time_of_need.title: In My Time of Need
quest.nirncraft.side_time_of_need.desc: Investigate the conflict between the Redguard maid Saadia and the Alik'r warriors.
quest.nirncraft.obj.time_of_need_3: Defeat Kematu and his Alik'r warriors
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.ask_time_of_nee: Who are those Redguard warriors in town?
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.pitch_time_of_n: The Alik'r are scouring the towns for a Redguard noblewoman. Ask around the inn.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.saadia_ask: Are you the one the Alik'r are hunting?
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.saadia_reply: They are assassins paid by the Aldmeri Dominion! Help me! Confront their leader Kematu before they find me!
quest.nirncraft.side_waking_nightmare.de: Aid the priest Erandur in purging the Daedric nightmares of Vaermina.
quest.nirncraft.obj.waking_nightmare_3: Confront the Skull of Corruption with Erandur
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.ask_waking_nigh: Why does everyone here look exhausted?
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.pitch_waking_ni: Nightmares haunt our sleep every night. Erandur, a priest of Mara, believes he can end the curse at the ruined temple.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.waking_nightmar: By the light of Mara, the temple is purified! The people may finally sleep in peace.
Unravel the dark conspiracy behind the assassinations and corruption in Markarth.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.ask_forsworn: What is happening in the Reach?
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.pitch_forsworn: Blood and silver flow in Markarth. Someone just dropped a cryptic message in the market...
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.forsworn_invest: I found this note left in the marketplace.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.forsworn_shrine: Meet me at the Shrine of Talos in secret. The guards are listening.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.madanach_breako: Madanach, your reign over the Reach ends here.
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.madanach_reward: The Silver-Bloods made me their prisoner, but the Reach belongs to the Forsworn!
quest.nirncraft.college_destruction.desc: Prove your mastery of flame and frost by purging an unstable elemental breach.
quest.nirncraft.obj.college_dest_3: Report back to the College of Winterhold
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.college_dest_re: I have quelled the elemental breach.
quest.nirncraft.reply.college_dest_done: Remarkable focus. You have earned the right to learn our most devastating Destruction tomes.
quest.nirncraft.college_restoration.desc: Prove the power of Restoration by sanctifying an ancient crypt overrun by restless dead.
quest.nirncraft.obj.college_rest_3: Report back to the College of Winterhold
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.college_rest_re: The crypt is cleansed and sanctified.
quest.nirncraft.reply.college_rest_done: Restoration is a valid school of magic, indeed. You may now master its greatest secrets.
quest.nirncraft.college_alteration.title: Alteration Ritual: Heart of Aetherium
quest.nirncraft.college_alteration.desc: Stabilize a fracture in reality and neutralize anomalous constructs.
quest.nirncraft.obj.college_alt_3: Report back to the College of Winterhold
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.college_alt_ret: The reality fracture has been stabilized.
quest.nirncraft.reply.college_alt_done: Fascinating work! You now have access to our most advanced Alteration spells.
quest.nirncraft.college_conjuration.desc: Track down a renegade conjurer and banish rogue summoned Daedra.
quest.nirncraft.obj.college_conj_3: Report back to the College of Winterhold
dialogue.nirncraft.quest.college_conj_re: The renegade conjurer has been defeated.
quest.nirncraft.reply.college_conj_done: The Void respects only the strong. You are ready for our highest Conjuration tomes.
quest.nirncraft.college_illusion.title: Illusion Ritual: The Unseen Thread
quest.nirncraft.college_illusion.desc: Pierce through illusions in a phantasmal hollow and subdue the Master of Mirages.
quest.nirncraft.obj.college_ill_3: Report back to the College of Winterhold
quest.nirncraft.reply.college_ill_done: You see truth behind the veil. Advanced Illusion tomes are now open to you.
dialogue.nirncraft.college.dest_start: Head to the Pyromancer's Crucible and quench their flames. Then return.
dialogue.nirncraft.college.rest_start: Cleanse the Desecrated Catacombs of evil spirits. Go with Arkay's blessing.
dialogue.nirncraft.college.alt_start: Seek the fracture in reality and calm the anomalous construct.
dialogue.nirncraft.college.conj_start: Track the rogue conjurer to their circle and end their profane bindings.
dialogue.nirncraft.college.ill_start: Enter the Phantasmal Hollow and see through the trickery. Trust nothing.
story.nirncraft.default.reply: Good. That's one thing less to worry about.
story.nirncraft.default.word: Learn a Word of Power of %s
story.nirncraft.reward.title: You are now known as: %s
story.nirncraft.reward.house_gold: %s already has an owner, so you were paid its worth instead: %s gold.
story.nirncraft.title.guild_master: Guild Master of the Thieves Guild
story.nirncraft.skip.not_yet: This step can't be skipped yet. Give it a few more days.
story.nirncraft.essential: %s staggers, wounded, but will not fall.
journal.nirncraft.skip_hint: This step has been unfinished for days. If something broke it (a lost quest item, a missing person), skip it and the quest goes on.
dialogue.nirncraft.story.local_work: Is there work to be found in %s?
dialogue.nirncraft.story.uncharted: Heard any word of uncharted lands?
dialogue.nirncraft.story.bring: I found what you were looking for.
dialogue.nirncraft.story.parcel: I have a delivery for you.
quest.nirncraft.province_imperial_cull.d: Undead are crawling out of an Ayleid ruin to the %s, in %s. The county wants them put back.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_imperial_: There's an old elven ruin to the %s, and lately its dead won't stay down. The Legion's busy. %s septims if you'll do what they won't.
A scholar in %2$s wants a welkynd stone from a ruin to the %1$s.
quest.nirncraft.obj.province_imperial_re: Take a welkynd stone from the ruin
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_imperial_: Welkynd stones: Ayleid starlight in glass. There's one in a ruin to the %s. %s septims, and I'll write a footnote about you.
quest.nirncraft.province_imperial_delive: A sealed packet for someone in %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_imperial_: The Imperial post is a week behind. Take this packet to %s, and there's %s septims in it for you.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_imperial_: From the capital? Finally. Thank you, courier.
quest.nirncraft.province_dunmer_cull.des: Ash ghouls are walking out of the storms to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_dunmer_cu: Ash ghouls, outlander. They walk out of the storms to the %s and into our farms. The House pays %s drakes, if you'll stop them.
quest.nirncraft.province_dunmer_relic.de: Grave-robbers took an ancestor's urn from a family tomb to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_dunmer_re: Thieves broke our family tomb to the %s and took my grandmother's ashes. She is very angry. Bring her home, and %s drakes are yours.
quest.nirncraft.province_dunmer_delivery: A Great House letter for %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_dunmer_de: House business, outlander, and none of yours. Carry this to %s. %s drakes.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_dunmer_de: The seal is intact. Good. The House remembers those who don't open its letters.
quest.nirncraft.province_argonian_cull.d: Wamasu are hunting the trails to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_argonian_: Wamasu, warm-blood. Big ones, hungry ones, on the trails to the %s. This one will pay %s coins for their deaths.
Sap-thieves bled a Hist tree to the %s, in %s, and hid the sap.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_argonian_: Thieves bled our Hist to the %s and hid the sap. The tree grieves. Bring it home: %s coins.
The marsh eats letters. Carry this one to %s for us, and %s coins are yours.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_argonian_: The marsh let it through. The Hist is kind today.
quest.nirncraft.province_khajiit_cull.de: Raiders strike the caravan roads to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_khajiit_c: Raiders on the caravan road to the %s, walker. Khajiit cannot sell to the dead. %s gold if you chase them off.
quest.nirncraft.province_khajiit_relic.d: A sack of moon sugar was stolen and hidden to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_khajiit_r: Thieves took this one's moon sugar, blessed by both moons. It is hidden to the %s. %s gold, and do not taste it.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_khajiit_d: The caravan leaves without this message, and it must not. Bring it to %s, walker. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_khajiit_d: Ah, the caravan's word! The sands are kind to you, friend.
quest.nirncraft.province_bosmer_cull.des: Spriggans have gone wild in the woods to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_bosmer_cu: The spriggans to the %s have turned on us. The Pact says we may not cut the wood, but it says nothing about you. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.province_bosmer_relic.de: A graht-oak acorn was stolen from a sacred grove to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_bosmer_re: Someone took a graht-oak acorn from a grove to the %s. A walking tree, stolen! Bring it back: %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_bosmer_de: Carry this to %s. Don't stop for meat-pies on the way. Well, one. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_bosmer_de: Good runner. The trees saw you coming.
quest.nirncraft.province_altmer_cull.des: Sea elf raiders landed to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_altmer_cu: Maormer, landed on our shore to the %s. The Thalmor will take days. I can offer %s gold, and my gratitude, which is worth more.
quest.nirncraft.province_altmer_relic.de: An ancient crystal lies unguarded, or nearly, to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_altmer_re: A crystal of the old Aldmer lies in a ruin to the %s. It belongs in a collection. Mine. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_altmer_de: Deliver this to %s. Do not fold it. Do not breathe on it. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.province_redguard_cull.d: The dead walk in the dunes to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_redguard_: The dead rise in the dunes to the %s. A sword is a prayer here; go and pray. %s gold.
A Yokudan relic blade lies in a tomb to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_redguard_: My ancestor's sword lies in a tomb to the %s, and the tomb does not want to give it up. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.province_redguard_delive: A message across the sands to %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_redguard_: Carry this to %s, and don't let the sand have it. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_redguard_: Across the Alik'r and dry? You have my thanks, and my water.
quest.nirncraft.province_breton_cull.des: A witch coven has made camp to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_breton_cu: Witches, to the %s, stealing children and cattle. Mostly cattle. The court offers %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.province_breton_relic.de: A dangerous spellbook is kept in a ruin to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_breton_re: A coven's grimoire lies in a ruin to the %s. The Mages Guild wants it. Don't read it. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_breton_de: A letter for %s. A love letter, a threat, or both; I'm a Breton, it's hard to say. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_breton_de: Oh. Oh my. Tell no one what was in this.
quest.nirncraft.province_orc_cull.title: Mountain Trolls
quest.nirncraft.province_orc_cull.desc: Trolls threaten the stronghold's herds to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_orc_cull: Trolls in the hills to the %s, eating our goats. Kill them and you eat with us. Also %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.province_orc_relic.title: Malacath's Idol
quest.nirncraft.province_orc_relic.desc: A stolen idol of Malacath is hidden to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_orc_relic: Someone stole the stronghold's idol of Malacath and hid it to the %s. The Furious One is furious. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_orc_deliv: The chief has words for %s. Carry them. Don't add any. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_orc_deliv: Hm. Strong words. Tell the chief we heard them.
quest.nirncraft.province_foreign_cull.de: Unknown creatures roam the land to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_foreign_c: Beasts we have no name for prowl to the %s. Kill them before they name us. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.province_foreign_relic.d: An artifact of an older people lies to the %s, in %s.
quest.nirncraft.pitch.province_foreign_r: There's something old to the %s, older than any of us here. Bring it to me. %s gold.
quest.nirncraft.reply.province_foreign_d: A message from so far? Thank you, traveler.
quest.nirncraft.uncharted_expedition.des: A cartographer will pay well for the first true chart of %s, which lies %s, %s blocks across the sea or the wastes.
quest.nirncraft.obj.uncharted_survey: Survey the land (take a few minutes to look around)
quest.nirncraft.pitch.uncharted_expediti: Every map I own ends in a sea serpent. Somewhere %2$s, %3$s blocks off, lies %1$s, and nobody's charted it. Go, look, come back alive, and I'll pay %4$s gold.
quest.nirncraft.uncharted_survey.title: Uncharted: %s
quest.nirncraft.uncharted_survey.desc: No map shows %s. If I chart its high places and whatever lairs there, the cartographers of Tamriel will pay for it.
quest.nirncraft.intro.0: You came north on the Imperial road, a hired sword with a sealed letter and not much else.
quest.nirncraft.intro.1: At the border gate of Helgen the Legion was turning travellers back. Smoke hung over the northern mountains.
quest.nirncraft.intro.2: You had barely reached the front of the line when the guards began to stare at the sky.
quest.nirncraft.intro.3: Whatever is coming, you do not mean to be standing here when it arrives.
quest.nirncraft.intro.guard: <Gate Guard> The gate is shut, traveller. Something is wrong in the north. Take the road to Riverwood and warn them. Go, now.
quest.nirncraft.intro.pointer: Your compass now points toward Riverwood.
quest.nirncraft.intro.journal: I woke in the cottage on the hill to a sound like a landslide, and watched a dragon burn Helgen from a distance. Somebody down there may still be alive. I will take the road and see.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.a: You wake to a low rumble that is not thunder. The shutters rattle in their frames.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.b: Through the window lies the valley. Helgen sits inside its walls, and something dark is lifting off the keep.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.c: A dragon. Nobody alive has seen one. Fire runs over the rooftops, and the horns begin, far too late.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.d: Columns of smoke climb the sky. Even from here you can hear the screaming.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.e: Then the wings turn away over the ridge and the valley goes quiet. Someone down there is still alive. Take the road and find out who.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.title: Helgen is burning
quest.nirncraft.intro2.subtitle: Follow the road down to the town.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.hint: Something is wrong outside. Go to the big window and look.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.key: A heavy iron key lies in your pack: the cottage key. Use it on the door.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.locked: The door is barred from the inside. Whatever is happening out there, you will see it from the window first.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.left: The latch falls shut behind you. The road lies below.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.loading.title: The valley wakes
quest.nirncraft.intro2.loading.sub: The hills and the town are coming into view.
quest.nirncraft.intro2.loading.tip: You will be able to look around the cottage in a moment.
tooltip.nirncraft.cottage_key: Opens the cottage door once. It was made for you alone.
quest.nirncraft.obj.uncharted_lair: Clear the lair of the land's great beast
